ns2:course.label: Special Topics in Neuroscience
ns2:course.description: Discussion of current topics of interest in neuroscience; seminar or lecture format. 1 to 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated up to 12 hours as topics vary. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
